text.text_excerpt: Tuesday night hot spot in the 7th Ward. This place was recommended by our friend as the place to see some "real" jazz music in New Orleans. We were not disappointed. Got to the club around 7 and the place was already starting to fill up. By 8 Kermit Ruffins and crew hit the stage. the band was tight...they played a wide range of classics and familiar tunes with their own take on things. Great mix of locals and travelers. We left before the first set was over, but I imagine they carried on through most of the evening. When I asked the cab driver to take me to Bullet's Sports Bar, his reaction of "Uh, I don't know how to get there," indicated either one of two things: A. That I was a crazy tourist who didn't know what I was getting myself into. B. That not many tourists knew about this totally awesome place. Turns out he just really never heard of the place and didn't know how to get there. So, with my keen sense of direction (iPhone) we headed towards Bullet's. I had read a lot about this place beforehand, but still, even with all of the information I had digested, I still didn't really know what to expect. Bullets is the real deal. Go on a Tuesday when Kermit Ruffins plays. Cheap beer, amazing food cooked streetside, great music, even better people. Definitely worth the trip!
